summary: Iter 57 shipper-relations Orisei welcome-kit end-to-end verification. Backend: 10/11 pytest cases passed (91%). PDF endpoint returns Orisei-branded PDF ≥40KB, no Walmart/Bentonville leakage, contains company_name and greeting keywords. send-welcome mock delivery response shape correct (id starts em-mock-, provider=resend-mock, to, subject 'Welcome to…', status=queued, attachment{filename,size_bytes,content_b64_preview}, greeting_preview, pdf_bytes>10k). Greeting personalization verified (Hi Alex parsed from 'Alex Buyer', company mentioned, Orisei mentioned, NO HTML entities — real Unicode apostrophes). 422 returned for account without contact_email. welcome-history sorted desc with WK- prefix. ROI snapshot appears after patching annual_volume_loads=250. Regression smoke on dashboard/accounts/create/log-activity all 200. Frontend: sidebar nav-shipper-intake absent, nav-shipper-relations present. /shipper-relations loads under admin, Accounts tab → click TEST_Acme row → modal opens showing cyan-bordered 'Orisei welcome kit' card with sender input, Preview PDF & Send welcome kit buttons. Filling sender 'Alex · Orisei Dispatch' + click Send → green delivery-receipt block renders with provider=resend-mock, to=alex.buyer.*@example.com, subject 'Welcome to ORISEI Freight Solutions — a personal note & our onboarding kit', attachment 'orisei_welcome_SHP-*.pdf · 418 KB', personalized greeting preview. TEST_NoEmail account → Send button disabled=true (correct guard). Old /shipper-intake ROUTE still resolves and renders (no 404).

critical.issue: Collection name mismatch: send-welcome writes the auto-generated activity into db.shipper_activities (routes/shipper_relations.py:786) but the 360° account view reads from db.shipper_activity_log (routes/shipper_relations.py:301). Effect: after sending a welcome kit the follow-up GET /accounts/{id} returns activity=[] — the required auto-log is invisible to the UI's Activity Log section. Direct violation of iter-57 review requirement #6 ('After a successful send-welcome, an activity is auto-logged: GET /api/shipper-relations/accounts/{account_id} shows an activity with kind=email and summary containing Welcome kit sent'). Also related: the shipper_activities doc uses activity_id prefix 'AC-' whereas the canonical activity_log uses 'ACT-'. Fix: change line 786 from db.shipper_activities.insert_one → db.shipper_activity_log.insert_one, and 'AC-' → 'ACT-' for prefix consistency.

action_items: Change db.shipper_activities.insert_one to db.shipper_activity_log.insert_one in routes/shipper_relations.py line ~786, and update activity_id prefix from 'AC-' to 'ACT-' to match log_activity() at line 358. This is the ONLY blocker for iter-57 acceptance criterion #6.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/shipper_relations.py:786 — writes to db.shipper_activities (a new/separate collection) while every other activity log write (line 341, 364) targets db.shipper_activity_log. Two collections storing the same conceptual data is a maintenance bomb; a future dev querying 'all activities' will miss the welcome-kit sends. Also, activity_id prefixes ('AC-' vs 'ACT-') are inconsistent.
routes/shipper_relations.py:719-720 — the leftover SendWelcomeIn_inner: noqa placeholder class serves no purpose now that SendWelcomeIn is module-level. Remove to reduce noise.

routes/shipper_relations.py:585-596 — _active_brand() is the 4th duplicated copy of this helper (see iter-56 report; lighthouse.py, qbr_studio.py, claims_master.py all have identical logic). Strongly recommend extracting to backend/services/brand.py::get_active_brand(db) — the iter-56 root-cause bug was a direct consequence of this duplication.

routes/shipper_relations.py:_render_welcome_pdf — builds the markdown in-memory and calls build_branded_markdown_pdf on every request; for a 418KB output this is ~0.5-1s CPU. If /welcome.pdf gets called frequently for the same account, consider caching by (account_id, brand_id, updated_at) hash.

frontend/src/pages/ShipperRelations.jsx — Sonner toast for 'Welcome kit sent to …' was not detectable via [role=status] selector in playwright; the receipt block renders correctly so users still see feedback. Non-blocking, but toast selector consistency across the app (some use sonner, some react-hot-toast) is worth normalizing.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE: In /app/backend/routes/shipper_relations.py, the send_welcome() endpoint (line 735) auto-logs the outbound email as an activity by calling `await db.shipper_activities.insert_one(...)` on line 786. However, the account 360° view endpoint (line ~285-315) reads activities via `await db.shipper_activity_log.find({...}).to_list(200)` on line 301. Two different collection names (shipper_activities vs shipper_activity_log) → the welcome-kit activity is orphaned in a collection nothing else queries. REPRODUCTION: 1) POST /api/shipper-relations/accounts/{id}/send-welcome on an account with contact_email → 200 OK, delivery receipt returned. 2) GET /api/shipper-relations/accounts/{id} → activity=[]. Expected: activity list contains one item with kind='email' and summary starting 'Welcome kit sent'. Also, the activity_id prefix used for the welcome activity is 'AC-' (line 774), inconsistent with the canonical 'ACT-' prefix used by log_activity() (line 358) and lifecycle mover (line 342). MITIGATION: change 'shipper_activities' → 'shipper_activity_log' at line 786, and 'AC-' → 'ACT-' at line 774. Zero data migration needed because the shipper_activities collection is brand-new to iter-57 and only contains test rows.
